movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Holding small sticks; in one version, holding ropes tied to a central pole.

signature_moves.description: Dancers hold ropes tied to a central pole and weave them while dancing.
signature_moves.name: Rope weaving

signature_moves.description: Striking own sticks or partner's sticks to create rhythm.
signature_moves.name: Stick striking

music_profile.sound_description: The sound is primarily percussive, created by the tapping and striking of small sticks held by the dancers.

basic_steps: Weaving ropes while moving in a circle
